```{r}
# 1. Load the relevant software libraries

library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(rio)

```

```{r}
#2. Import the data

RawChinaData <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wellsdata/CompText_Jour/refs/heads/main/data/ChinaFDI-LAT_tidy.csv")

```

```{r}
# 3. Use code to count the number of unique articles in the dataset

RawChinaData |>
  select(article_nmbr) |> 
  n_distinct()

```
#Cleaning junk
```{r}
#4. Remove useless metadata such as "Los Angeles Times" and "ISSN". See sample code below
China_cleaned <- RawChinaData %>%
  mutate(text = str_squish(text)) %>% #gets rid of leading and trailing spaces + double spaces
  mutate(text = tolower(text)) %>%
  mutate(text = str_replace(text, "startofarticle", "")) %>%
  mutate(text = gsub("issn:\\s+\\S+", "", text)) %>%
 mutate(text = str_remove_all(text, "https?://\\S+")) |> 
  mutate(text = str_remove_all(text, "\\d{2}\\s+[a-z]{3,9}\\s+\\d{4}(?:[:;,\\.\\s]+[a-z]\\.\\d+)?")) %>%
  mutate(text = str_remove_all(text, "[:;,\\.\\[\\]]")) %>%
  mutate(text = str_replace_all(text, c(
    "copyright" = "",
    "database: proquest central" = "",
    "language of publication: english" = "",
    "document url:\\s+\\S+" = "",
    "proquest document id:\\s+\\S+" = "",
    "publication subject:\\s+\\S+" = "",
    "publication date:\\s+\\S+" = "",
    "pages:\\s+\\S+" = "",
    "publication info" = "",
    "last updated:\\s+\\S+" = "",
    "interest periodicals--united states" = "",
    "https://+/docview/\\d+\\?accountid=\\d+" =""
  ))) %>%
  mutate(text = str_replace_all(text, c(
    "search.proquest.com" = "",
    "los angeles times" = "",
    "los angeles" = "",
    "calif" = ""))) 

```

Zirong

#filter the body text only
```{r}


China2 <- RawChinaData |>
  mutate(text = str_squish(text)) |>        # trim extra spaces
  group_by(article_nmbr) |>
  mutate(
    line       = row_number(),
    # body starts after the "Body" line
    body_start = which(text == "STARTOFARTICLE")[1],
    # body ends at the first of these markers (photo captions, Newstex notes, BI footer, Load-Date)
   body_end   = coalesce(which(str_detect(text, regex("^Classification:", ignore_case = TRUE)))[1], n() + 1L)
  ) |>
  filter(line > body_start, line < body_end) |>
  ungroup() |>
  # drop blank rows
  filter(!is.na(text), text != "") |>
  # drop leftover boilerplate lines inside the body
  filter(!str_detect(text, regex(paste(
    "^Link to (image|the original story)",
    "^Access PDF version",
    "^Click here for updates",
    "^ABSTRACT$",
    "^Dive Brief:?$",
    "^\\[Sign up for",
    "^For the latest news, weather",
    "^Correction",
    "^Update \\d",
    "^_+$",
    "^Photo:",
    "^TM & ©",
    "Copyright|All rights reserved",
    sep = "|"), ignore_case = TRUE))) |>
  # drop short byline lines like "By Deidre McPhillips, CNN"
  filter(!(str_detect(text, "^By [A-Z]") & str_length(text) < 60)) |>
  # strip the Newstex prefix and any URLs
  mutate(text = str_remove(text, "^.*Delivered by Newstex\\)\\s*"),
         text = str_remove_all(text, "https?://\\S+|www\\.\\S+")) |>
  select(-line, -body_start, -body_end)

# check: should be 100 articles
# body_df |> count(filename) |> summarise(n_articles = n(), min = min(n), max = max(n))

```
